items.question: By what numerical scope does a fixed count of womb-diagrams determine the extent to which beings are tormented?
premises: A count of eighty-four applies to a large set of thousands.
That set consists of womb-diagrams as specified.
Beings within those womb-diagrams are in a tormented state.
items.inference: The torment afflicts beings across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact scope of agency for the torment remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
